content: Chromium branding lives in a plain key=value file at chrome/app/theme/$branding_path_component/BRANDING, selected by the GN arg branding_path_component. Fields: COMPANY_FULLNAME, COMPANY_SHORTNAME, PRODUCT_FULLNAME, PRODUCT_SHORTNAME, PRODUCT_INSTALLER_FULLNAME, PRODUCT_INSTALLER_SHORTNAME, COPYRIGHT. version_info::GetProductName() reads it, so it is required to build. Mac bundle id is NOT in BRANDING - handled elsewhere; reports exist of DMG output keeping Chromium branding after editing BRANDING alone, i.e. one file does not cover every surface.
